findings.d10_compat: An optional second parameter works on every core; a required one breaks Drupal 10 and 11.0-11.2.
findings.fix: Keep the one-parameter signature, or add the new parameter as optional: ?CacheableMetadata $cacheability = NULL.
findings.message: legacy_widgets_entity_operation() implements hook_entity_operation(), which core invokes with 2 argument(s) from Drupal 11.3; the current 1-parameter form works on every core. If you accept the new parameter, keep it optional while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.

findings.fix: While the floor is below 11.2: keep the ->original property, or wrap the call in DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall() (core 10.1+): backwardsCompatibleCall(\Drupal::VERSION, '11.2', fn() => $entity->getOriginal(), fn() => $entity->original). Raise the floor to ^11.2 to use it directly.
findings.message: EntityInterface::getOriginal()/setOriginal() exists only from Drupal 11.2, below the core floor (10.0): a fatal on older cores unless the receiver is the module's own class. Guard it (DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall) or raise the floor to ^11.2.

findings.d10_compat: Core's getOriginal() does not exist below 11.2: code kept for ^10 must not call it on core entities (use the deprecated ->original property, or DeprecationHelper::backwardsCompatibleCall()).
findings.fix: While the core floor is below 11.2: rename the local helper (e.g. getOriginalWidget()) and update its callers. Once the floor is ^11.2: delete it and use core's getOriginal().
findings.message: LegacyWidget::getOriginal() collides with core's EntityInterface::getOriginal() added in Drupal 11.2 and is incompatible (return type 'none' (core: ?static or static)): a fatal 'Declaration must be compatible' when the class loads on 11.2+.

findings.d10_compat: Safe for ^10 || ^11: 10.2+ accepts the argument, and PHP ignores an extra argument on older 10.x/9.x cores.
findings.fix: Add TypedConfigManagerInterface $typed_config_manager to the subclass constructor, forward it (parent::__construct($config_factory, $typed_config_manager)) and pass $container->get('config.typed') from create().
findings.message: SettingsForm::__construct() passes 1 argument(s) to ConfigFormBase::__construct(), which requires 2 from Drupal 11.0: ArgumentCountError on Drupal 11.

findings.d10_compat: Never add #[\Override] to it while the core floor is below 11.3: the parent method does not exist there and PHP 8.3+ fatals at compile time.
findings.fix: Rename the module's helper (e.g. buildWidgetRevisionCacheId()) unless overriding core's revision cache id on 11.3+ is intended; if kept, match protected function buildRevisionCacheId($id): string exactly.
findings.message: LegacyWidgetStorage::buildRevisionCacheId() is a module method below Drupal 11.3 and silently OVERRIDES core's ContentEntityStorageBase::buildRevisionCacheId() from 11.3 (core calls it). Rename it unless that override is intended; never mark it with the Override attribute while the floor (10.0) is below 11.3.
